messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Silverline surfaced as a renewal risk (60d). They're seeing latency spikes on Dedicated during heavy ingest. Proposing a 60m focused enablement session for their infra + app owners to: 1) reduce p99, 2) validate rollout plan, 3) agree on immediate mitigations. Who can host? Proposed slots: Wed 10am PDT / Thu 9pm CEST / Fri 9am SGT. Need runbook + a recent trace/sample traffic.

Omar (Enablement): I can host Wed 10am PDT. Will cover routing policies, batching and quick knobs. Need the trace & current instance config. @Maya can you request from Silverline? :thumbsup:

Rajat (Solutions): I can do the quantization + batching deep-dive. Thu 9pm CEST works best for me, but I can prep async if we lock Wed or Fri.

Maya (CSM): Silverline prefers earlier in their local morning (SGT) so Fri 9am SGT might be ideal. @cs-bot can you spin up a quick poll?

cs-bot: Poll created -> https://polls.re/redwood/silverline-enable (options: 1) Wed 10am PDT 2) Thu 9pm CEST 3) Fri 9am SGT). Please vote by EOD.

Elena (CS Ops): I can host Fri 9am SGT if Omar can't. I'll own agenda + slides and add a short QA block. Also will prepare a minimal test dataset and a runbook checklist for engineers.

Omar (Enablement): If customer insists on Fri SGT I can switch — say :ok_hand: to that.

Maya (CSM): Tentative decision: Fri 9am SGT. Rajat — please prep the quant+batching deck. Elena — you own agenda. I'll confirm with Silverline and send calendar invite with Zoom + prework.

Rajat (Solutions): Uploaded draft deck to /drive/silverline/enablement/v0.1 — will polish and add a 10-min demo. @Elena please send the test dataset schema and any customer constraints.

Elena (CS Ops): Got it — sharing schema now. Agenda draft: 1) 5m intro & goals 2) 15m infra observation walkthrough (customer trace) 3) 20m tuning + batching plan 4) 10m config walkthrough 5) 10m QA 6) 5m action items. Adding links: https://drive.redwood/silverline/agenda-draft

Maya (CSM): I'll confirm with Silverline by 3pm PT today and ask them to upload a short trace + their current instance config to the shared folder. If confirmed I'll create invite and tag owners. Post-session follow-up to include config diff + KPIs to track.

cs-bot: Reminder scheduled -> attach trace + config to case #SL-4387 after upload.

Rajat (Solutions): Quick calendar helper if useful: ```/calendar create --title "Silverline Enablement" --when "2025-06-20T09:00:00+08:00" --duration 60 --zoom --guests "Maya,Elena,Omar,Rajat"```

Elena (CS Ops): Adding a 15-min action-items review to ensure clear owners. I'll draft follow-up template: owner, action, due date, success metric.

Maya (CSM): Thanks team — once Silverline confirms I'll mark this as high-priority on the renewal playbook and loop in the AE.

Omar (Enablement): :thumbsup: I'll prep a short checklist of quick rollback points and safe throttles we can recommend during the session.

Rajat (Solutions): Will add a short sample `kv-cache` config snippet to the deck.

Maya (CSM): Vote update: customer confirmed Fri 9am SGT. Assigning: Elena (host/agenda), Rajat (tech deep-dive), Omar (ops & runbook). I'll send invite and prework now.

Elena (CS Ops): Copy — will publish final agenda + slides by EOD tomorrow.

cs-bot: Calendar invite created and sent.
